skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain specific issues related to Management Information Systems.
Deploy certain stages of the process for analyzing, designing, developing, operating, and managing information systems to support solving specific issues related to Management Information Systems.
Have skills in communication, time management, and resource management; be sensitive and adaptable to changes.
Write reports and present specialized topics related to plans, strategies, and execution of assigned activities.
Develop skills in analyzing, designing, operating, and managing information systems in organizations and businesses.
Have skills in self-study and reading specialized literature.
Be able to work independently or actively, positively, and effectively in group activities.
Adhere to laws and regulations of the organization.
Have social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of Management Information Systems.
